title: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8.0 - Workload & Pod Security Standards

SEC-001.title: Apply Security Context to your Pods and Containers
SEC-001.remediation: Configure securityContext with non-root UID and restricted capabilities.

SEC-002.title: Ensure ImagePullPolicy is set to Always for mutable tags
SEC-002.remediation: Set spec.containers[*].imagePullPolicy: Always or pin image by digest.

SEC-003.title: Prefer using secrets as files over environment variables
SEC-003.remediation: Mount sensitive configurations as volume mounts instead of env variables.

SEC-006.title: Minimize the admission of privileged containers

SEC-007.title: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace

SEC-008.title: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host process ID namespace

SEC-009.title: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host IPC namespace

SEC-010.title: Minimize the admission of containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation

SEC-011.title: Minimize the admission of root containers

SEC-012.title: Minimize the admission of containers with read-only root file system

NET-001.title: Ensure Network Policies are defined for all namespaces
NET-001.remediation: Create NetworkPolicy resources specifying allowed ingress and egress flows.

NET-004.title: Create administrative boundaries between resources using namespaces
NET-004.remediation: Avoid deploying resources in default namespace; specify metadata.namespace.
